name: 15% Solutions
deliverable: Immediate identification of autonomous individual actions requiring no budget

steps.text: Ask each person: what is the 15 percent you can do right now, with the authority and resources you already hold?
Have everyone write one action in silence that needs no budget, no permission, and no one else's decision.
Pair people to read their action aloud and answer one question: what would make it easier to start this week?
Collect the actions on a shared board without ranking or editing them; the point is what is already possible.
Ask each person to name the day they will take the first step and what they will notice when it is done.
Close by asking what help each person needs from the room, and who in the room can give it.

failure: The group drifts into the 85 percent: a list of things leadership, budget, or another team must change, and no one names a move they can make.
intervention: Park the blockers on a separate list, then ask again what each person can do this week without waiting for them.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
